title: royascaff measure: data
description: The `data` of the contract envelope for `measure`. For an outcome (OUT-) `result` is `met` or `not-met`. Since contract 1.1 a person can also decide an experiment (EXP-): `result` (and `decision`) is `keep <variant>` or `stop`, `outcome` is the outcome the experiment serves, and `removal_slices` are the slices planned to remove the variants that lost. Extra fields are allowed: adding a field is a minor change.
